name: DOT IIJA funding status through May 31, 2026
known_limitations: The report combines formula and discretionary funding and reports budget authority, grants announced, obligations, and outlays in separate lifecycle columns. It does not measure completed projects or transportation outcomes and is not comparable to GAO's mostly unobligated discretionary-award review without an explicit series break.
notes: Phase 56Y longitudinal delivery-and-outcome source. Collection: longitudinal-delivery-outcomes-2026.
